name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Use one Markdown vault for session handoff, source-attributed recall, read-only diagnosis, reviewed lesson proposals, verification evidence and backup recovery. Release v0.18.0 hardens file readers against hardlinks, adds structured-credential and resource limits to Jev requests, and gives unattended Jarvis generation bounded host-selected evidence with no model tools or automatic context. Jarvis now requires API authentication; subscription-only OAuth does not satisfy its strict bare mode. This is not an OS sandbox or an OWASP compliance certification. It preserves v0.17.1's bounded session injection, v0.17.0's optional Aside adapter, v0.16.0's long-run discipline and v0.15.0's authorized Jev-first direct questions with native Noul, Choice and Score. Jev is advisory; execution and action permissions remain with the host.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
